title: potentilla nubicola
intro: Potentilla nubicola, commonly known as Nivalis or Snowy Cinquefoil, is a perennial plant species in the rose family. It is known for its health benefits, particularly in traditional medicine, where it is used to treat various conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and astringent properties, which help to soothe and calm the body. Bioactive constituents of Potentilla nubicola include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
